item.weapon_effects_effect_weapon_critical_hi: Table for the second critical (always different from the hit’s type: heat, puncture, etc.). Required if you use Effect Weapon.
item.weapon_effects_increased_initiative_hint: While this weapon is equipped, add the listed bonus to your initiative total when initiative is rolled (Minor +2 … Superior +8). If several equipped weapons grant this, the bonuses stack.
item.weapon_effects_effect_weapon_hint: When you score a critical, you get one button. After the GM confirms, one d100 resolves the main critical and the same roll the extra (severity: Minor −2, Normal −1, Greater same letter on another table, Superior +1). The second dropdown always picks a different critical table (e.g. heat). Both outcomes apply to the target.
item.weapon_effects_increased_critical_hint: The critical severity from the attack result is increased by one step (e.g. C→D, E→F). If the raised severity is beyond E (F+), the attack uses two separate critical rolls instead of one.
item.weapon_effects_weapon_of_bleeding_hint: When you apply a bleeding (HPR) effect from a critical while this weapon is equipped, add +1 to the bleeding rate per round if the main critical severity was A–C, or +2 if it was D–E (RM 9.7 Weapon of Bleeding).
item.weapon_effects_fixed_severity_hint: If you pick A–E, the second critical (second table) always uses that letter whenever a critical occurred, regardless of the main severity. Leave “—” to derive severity from Minor/Normal/Greater/Superior.
item.weapon_effects_damage_multiplier_hint: Fixed damage multiplier for this weapon (e.g. "does double concussion hit damage"). Pre-selects and pre-applies the multiplier when confirming a critical with this weapon — x1 = no effect (default).
item.power_modifier_hint: A power point multiplier (x2, x3...) for the chosen realm, or a Spell Adder granting N free castings - spells cast without spending power points - of any spell the caster knows. Only one of the two applies at a time - switching modes resets the other.
item.drop_profession_only: Only professions can be dropped here.
item.modifiers_is_slaying_hint: When checked, a target matching one of the tags below always resolves on the Slaying critical column (Superlarge table), regardless of the target's own Critical Table setting. Independent of the OB bonus below — leave unchecked if this weapon should only get the tag-based OB bonus without forcing that critical table.
item.modifiers_is_slaying_needs_tags: Add at least one tag below first — a weapon can't be a Slayer of nothing.
item.modifiers_slaying_bonus_hint: Replaces (does not add to) this weapon's normal magic bonus when the target matches one of the Slaying tags above (e.g. "+10, +25 vs Orcs"). 0 = no extra bonus, just Slaying's critical column effect.
item.bonus_skill_categories_hint: Applies to every skill in the chosen category at once, instead of one named skill.
item.passive_modifiers_hint: Applied as Active Effects on the actor while the item is worn or equipped. Add and Subtract stack; Override sets the field value.
item.drop_skill_for_bonus: Drop skill here (from character or compendium)
item.drop_skill_only: Only skills can be dropped here.
item.enchantments_hint: Drag spells here to add enchantments. Use the delete button to remove.
item.enchantments_pool_hint: Shared charge pool for enchantments set to "Power pool" usage (e.g. an artifact with N points spent by several spells at different costs). Other usage types (Daily, Charged...) are unaffected.
item.enchantments_cast_level_hint: Fixed effective level used when casting this item's Force spells (e.g. a "30th level effect" artifact). 0 = use the wielder's real level.
item.enchantments_recharge_days_hint: Automatic power pool recharge period. Ticks down by 1 on every long rest (this system has no calendar, so a long rest is the only "time passes" signal). 0 = no automatic recharge — recharge the pool by hand whenever your artifact's own trigger happens (full moon, ritual...).
item.enchantments_days_until_recharge_hint: Days left until the next automatic recharge. Refills the pool to max and resets to "Recharges every" when it reaches 0.
item.enchantment_need_actor: Item must be owned by an actor to use this enchantment.
item.enchantment_not_identified: This item hasn't been identified yet.
item.enchantment_spell_not_found: Spell not found. The actor must own the spell to use this enchantment.
